biography.ja: スペイン・サグント生まれ。幼少期にジフテリアを患い、3歳で視力をほぼ失った。パリでポール・デュカスに師事し、演奏会用作品の作曲技法を本格的に学んだ。ピアノを主な楽器としていたが、ギターをほとんど演奏しないにもかかわらず、ギター協奏曲の最も有名な作品の一つを書いたことで世界的に知られている。
biography.en: Born in Sagunto, Spain, he contracted diphtheria in early childhood and lost most of his sight by the age of three. He studied in Paris under Paul Dukas, gaining a thorough grounding in concert composition. Though the piano was his primary instrument and he rarely played the guitar himself, he became world-famous for writing one of the most celebrated guitar concertos ever composed.

style.ja: スペインの民族的な旋律感覚とリズムを、フランスで学んだ洗練されたオーケストレーション技法と結びつけた作風を特徴とする。ギター協奏曲の代表作では、独奏ギターの繊細な音量を活かしつつオーケストラと対話させる難題に取り組み、緩徐楽章の抒情的な旋律で特に高い評価を得ている。
style.en: His style combines Spanish national melodic and rhythmic sensibility with the refined orchestration technique he acquired in France. In his best-known guitar concerto he tackled the challenge of letting a soft-voiced solo guitar converse with a full orchestra, and its lyrical slow-movement melody in particular has earned exceptional praise.

impact.ja: デュカスに師事した点でメシアンやミヨーと同じ師系に連なりながら、フランス印象主義とは異なりスペイン民族色を前面に出す道を選んだ。代表的なギター協奏曲はクラシック・ギターのレパートリーの中で最も広く知られる作品となり、視覚に障害を抱えながら国際的な名声を確立した作曲家として、その生涯そのものが広く語られている。
impact.en: Though sharing a teacher with Messiaen and Milhaud through his studies with Dukas, he chose a path that foregrounded Spanish national color rather than French impressionism. His best-known guitar concerto became the most widely recognized work in the classical guitar repertoire, and his life story, that of a composer who achieved international fame despite blindness, is itself widely told.
